## Brand & Style

This design system embodies an editorial-operational ethos: the exactitude of a master architectural atelier coupled with the fluid responsiveness of an autonomous booking and canvas workspace. - **Controlled Kinetic Elegance:** Micro-interactions mimic archival drawers and precision calipers—deliberate, smooth, and grounded.

## Colors

The palette relies on deliberate tonal compression between surfaces and deliberate contrast jumps for typography and active states. 

- **Primary Canvas (`#FAF7F2`):** Warm ivory representing untreated Japanese vellum or museum matboard. Used for global application canvas and wide-format studio views.
- **Surfaces & Cards (`#F5F0E8`):** Saturated cream with a dense, grounded presence. Houses operational modules, inspector panels, and node configurations.
- **Accents (`#B8860B` & `#D4A017`):** Dark goldenrod functions as an operative indicator—denoting focus, selected paths, primary commits, and real-time synchronization. Never used for decorative washes; its value lies strictly in precision signaling.
- **Ink Tiers (`#14110D`, `#3A332B`, `#8A7E6E`):** Soot-black primary text ensures pristine legibility against warm paper backgrounds, while olive-grey tertiary ink governs secondary operational metadata, architectural grid markers, and inactive boundaries.
- **Hairline Gold (`rgba(184, 134, 11, 0.25)`):** Used for micro-delineation, table cell boundaries, card separators, and blueprint guides.

## Typography

The typography unites three distinct voices into an architectural cadence:
1. **Classical Editorial Authority (EB Garamond):** Used exclusively for structural headers, primary workspace titles, and modal designations. It communicates deliberate curation, human heritage, and timeless precision.
2. **Rational Workhorse (Hanken Grotesk):** Neutral, crisp, and high-density legibility for parameter values, contextual descriptions, calendar bodies, and dynamic settings.
3. **Drafting Monospace (JetBrains Mono):** Reserved for technical instrumentation, coordinates, time indicators, room ratios, operational states, and micro tags. Always set with positive tracking for crisp readability at small scales.

1. Top bar (48px tall):
   - Cream background (#F5F0E8), bottom border 1px solid rgba(184, 134, 11, 0.25).
   - Left side: mono uppercase overline in gold "RIG DESIGN STUDIO" (text-[9px] tracking-[0.2em] font-mono text-[#B8860B]) above serif board title truncated to one line: "Iterate the Loehr HR-group landing…" (Cormorant Garamond italic or roman font-serif text-[15px] font-semibold text-[#14110D] truncate).
   - Right side: ghost icon button (min 44x44px) for the design-system panel with sliders/tune icon (lucide/svg sliders or tune).

   - Horizontal pill segments with mono uppercase labels:
     - "BOARD" (active state: filled with warm near-black #14110D, text warm ivory #FAF7F2, rounded-full px-4 py-1.5 font-mono text-[10px] tracking-wider)

3. Canvas area (fills viewport with subtle 24px grid pattern in rgba(184,134,11,0.08) on warm ivory #FAF7F2):

   - A vertical stack of three full-width artifact cards (cream #F5F0E8, rounded-2xl / 16px radius, border 1px solid rgba(184, 134, 11, 0.25), relative positioning):
     * Card 1:
       - Left vertical status edge: 3px solid #2E6F40 (green indicator for validated/ready).

       - Title: "Executive Persona & Behavioral Anchors" (2 lines, font-serif Cormorant Garamond text-lg font-bold text-[#14110D]).
       - Body: 2-line clamp summary "Synthesized interview vectors from Loehr talent leads into structured routing constraints." (text-xs text-[#3A332B] line-clamp-2).

       - Left vertical status edge: 3px solid #B8860B (gold indicator for in-progress).
       - Header: Mono kind label "CANVAS ROUTE" + deviation chip "dev +2" (subtle warning badge in #B8860B/15 with #B8860B text).
       - Title: "Autonomous Booking Intent Intake" (2 lines, font-serif Cormorant Garamond text-lg font-bold text-[#14110D]).
       - Body: 2-line clamp "Natural language parser for trip itinerary constraints, budget caps & team authority." (text-xs text-[#3A332B] line-clamp-2).
       - Right edge: Golden circular connect port with active connected glow.
     * Card 3:
       - Left vertical status edge: 3px solid #8A7E6E (gray indicator for pending/draft).
       - Header: Mono kind label "CODEGEN SPEC" + deviation chip "dev +0".
       - Title: "Dev Handoff Schema Serializer" (2 lines, font-serif Cormorant Garamond text-lg font-bold text-[#14110D]).
       - Body: 2-line clamp "Serializes canvas nodes, deviation thresholds, and edge links into coding agent payload." (text-xs text-[#3A332B] line-clamp-2).
       - Right edge: Golden circular connect port.

- **Operational Caliper Units:** Spacing builds on an 8-point baseline rhythm. Component interiors leverage tight nesting (`0.25rem` to `0.5rem`), while tool clusters and canvas docks preserve open, breathable negative space (`1.5rem` to `2.5rem`) to maintain calm focus.
- **Fixed vs. Infinite Canvas:** Canvas workplanes utilize infinite panning with absolute drafting grid steps (24px point-grid), while dock panels and booking schedule side-drawers anchor rigidly using structured margins and absolute viewport boundaries.

## Elevation & Depth

This system intentionally departs from synthetic, floating drop-shadows. Depth is achieved via **tonal stratification and architectural line layering**:

- **Level 0 (Canvas Base):** Flat `#FAF7F2` plane overlaid with an optional hairline dot-grid (`#8A7E6E` at 15% opacity).
- **Level 1 (Dock & Modules):** Surface plate `#F5F0E8` defined by a perimeter 1px border of `rgba(184, 134, 11, 0.25)`. No box shadow is applied under resting conditions.
- **Level 2 (Hover / Active Inspector):** Subtle ambient displacement. A 1px border in `#B8860B` accompanied by an ultra-soft tinted shadow: `0 8px 24px -4px rgba(20, 17, 13, 0.04), 0 2px 6px -1px rgba(184, 134, 11, 0.08)`.
- **Level 3 (Modals & Overlays):** `#F5F0E8` plate resting over a scrim of `rgba(20, 17, 13, 0.35)` with an unblurred hairline gold perimeter stroke (`#B8860B`) and a soft deep shadow `0 20px 48px -8px rgba(20, 17, 13, 0.12)`.

## Shapes

The shape vocabulary marries soft architectural corners with precision joins:
- **Base Components:** Standard 12px border radius (`rounded-md` equivalent in custom theme) applied to cards, control groups, inputs, and popovers to replicate thick-cut deckle-edge boards.
- **Primary Shelves & Modals:** 16px border radius (`rounded-lg` equivalent) on heavy operational panels, booking trays, and macro-canvases.
- **Instrument Tags & Calipers:** Micro-capsules (6px to 8px) applied to JetBrains Mono status chips and timeline indicators to prevent jarring boxiness while preserving systematic legibility.

## Components

### Buttons & Action Triggers
- **Primary:** Background `#B8860B`, text `#FAF7F2`, font `Hanken Grotesk` medium (14px). Subtle active scale down (0.985). Hover transitions smoothly to `#D4A017`.

### Inputs & Selectors

- Input text in `Hanken Grotesk` (14px), labels in uppercase `JetBrains Mono` (11px, `#8A7E6E`).

### Cards & Canvas Nodes

### Chips & Status Badges
